inputs.text: The “8 million” figure is just the organizers’ claim; authorities still haven’t provided a count. That silence makes it easy for the headline to portray scattered events as a unified national wave against Trump. The organizers’ claims of about one million more people and 600 more events than in October are part of the same sales pitch, not independent verification. It looks like coordinated narrative-building: using scale and repetition to manufacture momentum and make opposition seem more decisive than the evidence shows.

subtopics: Authorities have not provided a count
